name: Accordion
summary: A group of disclosures where opening one closes the others, natively.

guidance.useFor: A set of related questions or sections where people read one at a time: FAQs, delivery and returns details.
insteadUse: Content everyone needs: leave it on the page
Several sections worth comparing side by side: let them all open (a stack of Disclosures)
Switching between views of one thing: Tabs
content: Each summary is the question or the section's name, in sentence case
Keep each panel short; long content belongs on its own page

rungReason: <details name> makes a group exclusive natively: opening one closes the others, with no script.

a11y.role: A group of disclosures (no accordion role exists)
a11y.name: Each summary's text

states.via: [open] on one item at a time

keyboard.action: Open one; the open one closes

rules: For several open at once, leave out the name: it's then a stack of disclosures
